name: sam2-l4-local
benchmark_exclusion_reason: Requires the model-owned five-frame public C ABI
model_proof_exclusion_reason: Requires the externally provisioned local L4 bundle, five RGB8 frames, and golden evidence

testcases.name: sam2-l4-local

regression.previous_failure: The original SAM2 delivery lacked a compact reproducible proof that its public C ABI preserved five-frame mask and detector accuracy.
regression.prevents: The six-plan builder or native runtime silently degrading mask IoU, detector box, score, label, or five-frame tracking behavior.

testcases.notes: The dedicated L4 lane builds the caller-owned bundle and runtime locally, then the Python E2E runner invokes the public C ABI against five exact decoded RGB8 frames and golden evidence under --engine-dir. Missing inputs are failures; the repository stores none of those artifacts.
